newsitem.title: USA: Midland Bank files $1 bln shelf offering.
newsitem.headline: Midland Bank files $1 bln shelf offering.

text.p: Midland Bank filed Thursday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf offering of up to $1 billion in debt securities and preferred shares.
Together with previously registered securities, the company's shelf offering totals $1.5 billion
Proceeds from the sale will be used to support the development of and to strengthen the company's capital base, according to the SEC filing.
No underwriters were named in the filing.
